test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The following bar graph shows the sales of a company (in₹ crore) in different years. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27b2b8884d92cc1ca192d79dfbdd1aec46c7f7a549b7db259bafb7e685f7b20c.png] 

​The mean of the highest and lowest sales (in ₹ crore) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Highest sales in 2022 = ₹584 crore

Lowest sales in 2018 = ₹205 crore

**Formula used:**

The mean of the highest and lowest sales is given by:

Mean = frac{{Highest sales} + {Lowest sales}}{2}

**Calculations:**

Mean = (584 + 205)/(2)

⇒ Mean = (789)/(2)

⇒ Mean = 394.5 crore

**The mean of the highest and lowest sales is ₹394.5 crore.**
